meta.title: Discrepancy Resolution & Quarantine
meta.flowPosition: after 08 Barcode Verification, before 10 Receiving Decision
meta.note: Judgement stage. Backend-authoritative. Merges Screen 07 findings and Screen 08 mismatches into one issue list and requires a resolution for every issue. Output is an immutable Resolution Set consumed by Screen 10.

purpose: For every issue surfaced during inspection and barcode verification, the learner decides how to resolve it — accept, partially accept, quarantine, reject, or escalate to the supervisor — finalising the disposition of every flagged item before the shipment-level decision.
learningObjectives: Consolidate issues from inspection and barcode verification into one worklist
Apply the correct resolution action per issue severity and type
Recognise when an issue is ambiguous enough to require supervisor escalation
Avoid over-flagging (quarantining/rejecting items with no real issue)
Avoid under-flagging (accepting items with an unresolved critical issue)
Finalise the quarantine and reject lists for the shipment

input.note: Consumes Screen 07's findings + quarantineList and Screen 08's mismatches. The two lists are merged into a single issue worklist by the runtime; items already quarantined at Screen 07 still need a final disposition here (quarantine is provisional until this stage confirms it).

expected.findings: [{ item, type, severity, quantityAffected, notes, recommendedAction }]
expected.mismatches: [{ item, type, severity, expectedValue, scannedValue, quantityAffected, notes }]

supervisor.example: Ask yourself: can this item still be sold or used safely? If you're not sure, escalate rather than guess.
supervisor.note: Escalating is never penalised; escalating everything (no independent judgement) is.

scenarios.name: Safety-critical seal issue carried from Screen 06

definitions.escalation_appropriateness: escalated only issues genuinely marked ambiguous/safety-critical in the scenario, not routine ones
definitions.over_flagging: quarantined or rejected an item with no matching issue, or a moderate issue resolved as reject when quarantine was expected
definitions.under_flagging: accepted an item carrying a critical/unresolved issue

assessmentRules.note: Completion and correctness remain separate. A learner may resolve every issue (complete) while choosing the wrong action for several of them (low correctness).

completion.rule: Stage completes when every issue in the merged worklist (Screen 07 findings + Screen 08 mismatches) has a recorded resolution and the set is submitted.
completion.note: Completion = every issue resolved and submitted. Correctness/competency computed separately via assessmentRules.

output.note: The Resolution Set becomes an immutable part of the simulation attempt. Screen 10 consumes it, alongside the upstream stage summaries, to make the shipment-level decision.

shape.perIssueResolution: { issueId: accept | partial_accept | quarantine | reject | escalate_to_supervisor }
shape.evidenceRef: LearnerAction seq range for this stage
